name: Famicom Disk System
description: A 1986 add-on for Nintendo's Famicom in Japan that loaded games from rewritable floppy disks. It offered cheaper games, saving and an extra sound channel, and it was the first home for The Legend of Zelda and Metroid.

specs.memory: 32 KB RAM + 8 KB CHR RAM (RAM Adapter)

curiosities: Stores had Disk Writer kiosks that rewrote a disk with a new game for ¥500.
Its disks are a modified version of Mitsumi's Quick Disk format.
The Legend of Zelda first came out on the Disk System, with saves to the disk itself.
The RAM Adapter connects to the Famicom's cartridge slot.
